title: Active/wait/elapsed case time
operational_definition: For one defined case, record declared start/end and distinguish observed active work, waiting and interruption intervals without double counting.
required_data: Task identity/goal, event/recorded-time meaning, observed timestamps/intervals, participant context and permitted data.
interpretation: Elapsed time is not automatically system latency; unexplained idle time is not established waiting caused by a tool.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Repeated-entry and intentional-tailoring events
operational_definition: Count observed same-fact re-entry separately from deliberate tailoring, language maintenance, correction and new information.
required_data: Exact factual identity/intent, relevant change events and observed reason/classification where available.
interpretation: Repeated values or multiple resume versions alone are not waste; unknown reasons remain unknown.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Identity/version/meaning ambiguity
operational_definition: Record observed cases where intended source/draft/live/actual material/revision/subject cannot be established, with exact evidence and consequences.
required_data: Expected representation/subject/event and actual available identity/provenance/policy at the observed moment.
interpretation: A legitimate difference is not an error. Missing inspected evidence is not proof the real record is absent.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Defined follow-up/handoff outcome
operational_definition: For an explicit agreed expected action/deadline, compare actual observed action/outcome and distinguish changed expectation or missing evidence.
required_data: Intended recipient/next action, defined time/timezone/criteria and actual records/observation.
interpretation: Do not equate provider acceptance with recipient receipt, lateness with failure, or all tool switches with harmful delay.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Context retrieval/transition effort
operational_definition: Record the actual steps/handoffs needed to locate intended resource/context, with optional observed active/wait intervals.
required_data: Bounded same-goal case, observed resource/actor context, tool/step transitions and interruptions.
interpretation: A count of tools or clicks is not by itself a quality defect or proof one unified view is better.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Applicable authorization/result correctness
operational_definition: For a defined current policy and authorized controlled case, compare expected exact scope/result with actual observation.
required_data: Reviewed actor/resource/action/state policy, intended entry path, controlled inputs and actual permitted evidence.
interpretation: This is a separate verification design if synthetic; it is not an observed personal workflow or performed penetration test.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Actual-material completeness
operational_definition: For an inspected actual-submission case, distinguish confirmed required components, missing and unknown provenance/retention under the reviewed capture policy.
required_data: Actual event/material identity, required component definition and permitted retained evidence.
interpretation: No completeness rate with absent/undefined denominator; unknowns are reported separately and no latest-live substitution allowed.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Procedure effort and coverage
operational_definition: For a defined actual operating task, record steps/effort/dependencies/known covered outcome and limitations within the same project-time budget.
required_data: Identified environment/procedure/source/date, authorized non-secret observation and actual result.
interpretation: A plan or backup artifact is not a performed restore. Do not invent RPO/RTO or an operations allowance beyond 20 total hours/week.
actual_result: Not measured in this task; no numerical baseline or target benefit
target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Rework/interruption/repetition meaning
operational_definition: Classify actually observed correction, retry or new event by its intended cause/context and actual prior effect rather than counting every repeated action as rework.
required_data: Exact original/next operation context, observed state/evidence and stated reason if known.
interpretation: Missing response is not proof no effect; distinguish legitimate new submission/correction from harmful duplicate.

target_status: No sample size, threshold, time saving or improvement percentage selected

title: Paired improvement comparison
operational_definition: Compare explicitly matched baseline and candidate cases under defined equivalent goal/data/environment/criteria; record actual outcomes and limitations.
required_data: Real observed baseline and actual candidate run/feedback with compatible methods; annotate any material difference.
interpretation: With no baseline or candidate run there is no demonstrated improvement. No percentage/success/effect estimate can be derived from diagram/model counts.
